topic: My research primarily focuses on electrokinetic phenomena at micro- and nanoscales, including the fundamental mechanisms, interactions, and combined effects of various electrokinetic, diffusio-kinetic, and thermally driven transport phenomena. These include their investigation in microchannels, nanochannels, and nanopore systems connected to reservoirs, with an emphasis on understanding coupled transport processes and their potential applications. I am particularly interested in translating these fundamental studies into practical technologies such as energy harvesting, water desalination, electrodialysis, reverse electrodialysis, DNA sequencing, and the development of novel biomedical devices.
